title: Length of Last Word
statement: Given a string containing words separated by spaces, return the length of the final word.
A word is a maximal group of non-space characters, and the string may contain leading or trailing spaces.

examples.input: s = "   fly me   to   the moon  "

constraints: s consists of English letters and spaces.
There is at least one word in s.
